verified_endpoints.interpretation: Upper drawn end of the opposite #10 winding follows the conductor to the 7A8 oscillator anode grid (g2). The secondary alias denotes the right-hand drawn winding only; function/polarity are not established.
Manufacturer basing maps 7A8 oscillator anode g2 to pin 3; Philco and Rider drawings show its lead at the right-hand #10 upper winding end.

limits: The lower right winding endpoint and #12/#13 paths were subsequently reconciled in v0.53; this artifact retains the upper-end crosscheck.
Rider 12-45 is another scan of the Philco drawing. Agreement does not prove physical lug orientation or settle ambiguous crossing marks.
No winding polarity, coupling, inductance, four-dot contact allocation, chassis/B− bond or full oscillator behavior is inferred.
